directive.thread_id: writing-gate lane, part stands: tools/copy-gate/verdicts.mjs to tools/where-a-person-stands
directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired and renamed trillion-launch-video-completely-ported

old_copy.deleted_with: the launch-video removal pull request of the writing-gate lane, which deletes tools/copy-gate/verdicts.mjs and names this folder as its new home

preserve: the latest decision of each option governs
every unit of an option whose latest row is a picked verdict is good, except the lines its row names
the lines a rejection names are bad only while that option's latest row is a rejection
excluded strings, texts ruled on directly and texts picks label both ways are left out and counted
a pick whose spec is not found or not unique is listed, never guessed
a film takes part only when its pick settings carry pick_labels
allowed_deltas: the caller hands in each film's decisions, file list and option units (read by pick-gate and the unit reader) instead of this file running python and globbing a film folder; a matched spec whose units were not sent is listed in units_needed
the bad label, the real people and the field a ruling must carry come from the person's setting instead of being written in the code
the person's words on an option are their_words, and the ledger path is not echoed

the claim starts at line 255, inside pickItems: its doc comment and decisionsOf (lines 240-254) are carried in the file too, but outside the claimed lines, because those lines name the person and a contract would have to spell the name to redact it
banned_substitutions: a film folder, person or path written into the code
a pick written into the rulings list (a pick is not a line ruling)

test_refs: tools/where-a-person-stands/test/said-words-and-rulings.test.mjs picks imply examples: a picked option is good but for the lines it names, a rejection is bad only where it names lines
tools/where-a-person-stands/test/rulings-from-the-verdict-log.test.mjs picks follow the pick ledger: the latest picked row gives good, a standing rejection gives its named lines bad
